title: the commit's reseal carries the landing ticket as its ruling
intention: The pre-commit hook passes CAIRN_RESEAL_RULING, when the landing hand sets it, to the reseal as --ruling, so a build commit under an open repair ladder lands its seal when rung 4 admits that ticket; rung4_refusal still judges the id.
why: Measured 2026-11-24 on akiendelllinux (cairn dde12e2d0): the hook runs `cli --reseal --stage` (cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit) and names no ruling, while the cli takes --ruling beside --stage (cli.py:585, since e8be83a46ea9). On 11-24 b563bf636e5d's build commit was refused at rung 4 on test_scratch.py and resealed by hand with --ruling b563bf636e5d. Recorded at ~/.cairn/devices/cc/0/measurements/land-hook-gaps-2026-11-24.md.
how: In the hook, if CAIRN_RESEAL_RULING is non-empty, append --ruling "$CAIRN_RESEAL_RULING" to the reseal call; unset, the call is unchanged. The ladder's own judge decides whether the id admits the change; the hook only carries it. The installed copy follows by `cairn test --reseal-install`.

clauses.claim: run with a stub python in a scratch repo and CAIRN_RESEAL_RULING=<id>, the hook calls the reseal with --ruling <id>
with CAIRN_RESEAL_RULING unset or empty, the hook calls the reseal with no --ruling, as before

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit appends --ruling from CAIRN_RESEAL_RULING when set.
D2: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_commit_reseal_carries_the_landing_ruling.py, one PROVES key per clause.

out: rung4_refusal (unchanged: it still judges the id)
sail.py (a build commit is the landing hand's own git commit; sail makes none)

traces_to: Law 8 (a proof enters proven-space with its seal, taken by the tester, not by a hand that remembered) and Law 4 (the reseal door is physics; a gap a hand fills each time is policy).
